title: Sep 16 Results + Sep 17 Preview: When 73% Feels Like Coming Home
summary: 11-4 on Sep 16 with 73.3% accuracy. Tomorrow we're riding the Brewers again.

content.value:
## Here's the Thing About Consistency

Some days the model whispers. Other days it shouts. Yesterday? It sang a pretty clear tune, going 11-4 with 73.3% accuracy across the slate. Not perfect—we never claim to be—but the kind of day that reminds you why we trust the numbers even when our hearts want something different.

## The Day's Story in Numbers

The Guardians, Rays, Brewers, and Cubs all came through at 61% confidence—those were our most assured picks, and they delivered. The Giants squeaked by at just 51%, proving that sometimes the tightest calls are the sweetest wins.

The misses? The Yankees couldn't get it done in Minnesota, and the Dodgers stumbled in Cincinnati. Both were mid-range confidence picks, and that's exactly where variance lives. You take your 11-4 days and smile.

## Looking Ahead to September 17

Here's where it gets interesting. The Brewers showed up for us yesterday in Pittsburgh with that 61% confidence, and guess what? They're back at it again tomorrow in the same park. Kyle Harrison takes the mound for Milwaukee against Wilber Dotel for the Pirates.

The model likes Milwaukee again, though the confidence has cooled to 52%—essentially a coin flip with the slightest lean. These are the picks that test your faith in the process. Do you trust what worked yesterday? Do you believe in the incremental edge?

content.title: ⭐ Tomorrow's Top Pick - Sep 17
content.sub: Pick: Brewers (52%) · Kyle Harrison vs Wilber Dotel

content.value:
## The Human Angle

There's something poetic about back-to-back games in the same stadium. The Brewers know the dimensions now, know how the ball carries, know where the shadows fall. Harrison gets another crack at a Pirates lineup he might've been studying all night.

But 52%? That's the model being honest with us. It's not shouting. It's suggesting. And sometimes those whispers are worth listening to, especially when they come off an 11-4 day.

We'll be watching. You should too.

author: Hana
